persona: Calm and clear. Starts without signing in. Has two photos and the quote as a PDF that her phone saved from an email; she does not know the file is damaged.
initial_message: Hi, I need to report damage to my car. In the early hours of Wednesday 23 September the carport roof at our house collapsed under the heavy snow and came down on my car. The roof of the car is crushed and the windscreen is broken, so it had to be towed to a panel beater. Nobody was hurt.

facts.incident.description: It snowed heavily all Tuesday evening. At about 2am we heard a loud crack. In the morning we found that the timber carport had collapsed under the weight of the snow and the beams and roofing were lying on my car. A builder cut the beams away later that morning and the car was towed out.
facts.incident.location: 39 Upland Test Road, Lake Hayes Estate, Queenstown
facts.incident.cause: Heavy snow collapsed the carport roof onto the parked car
facts.loss.description: Car roof crushed in the middle, windscreen cracked all over, roof rails bent
facts.policyholder.name: Hana Driftwood
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Roof crushed in the middle, windscreen cracked all over, both A-pillar tops bent, roof rails bent
facts.vehicle.towing_location: Cedar Holt Auto Refinish, 6 Bellbird Test Drive, Frankton, Queenstown
facts.evidence.photos: Two photos from Wednesday morning: the car roof under the beams and the collapsed carport. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Cedar Holt Auto Refinish, saved from their email. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_driver: Nobody was driving. The car was parked in the carport overnight.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_total: They told me it was about $4,900 including GST.
facts.if_asked_about_resending_quote: I can ask Cedar Holt to email it again and send it through.
facts.if_asked_about_carport: The carport belongs to our house. I will sort that out separately; this claim is only for the car.
facts.if_asked_about_ongoing_risk: The carport has been cleared away. Nobody is at risk.

design.notes: The only quote is truncated and cannot be opened, so its date cannot be read: quote_before_loss is not checked, not clear. The claimant starts without an account and signs in before the first upload.

triage.rationale: The quote file cannot be opened, so the required quote is outstanding. The car cannot be driven (windscreen and roof) and was towed. The source quote totals NZD 4,864.50 including GST and the claimant says "about $4,900" if asked, but no readable document gives an amount, so whether the amount counts as known depends on whether the Agent asks; amount_over_threshold_or_unknown is allowed. Parked car, no other party, nobody hurt. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: The only quote is a truncated file that cannot be opened, so its date cannot be read

prior_claims_12m.basis: Starts anonymous and signs in before the first upload; the account has no earlier claims

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (30 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-06-30, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.note: Matched by file name: until the chat upload lets the claimant pick the material, the runner must not set evidence_kind through the API (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

The Agent tells the claimant that the carport or the house is covered or not covered under this motor policy.
